title: After pivoting, Y Combinator grad Glimpse raises $35M led by a16z

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: A startup just raised $35M — and it's not your average tech company.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This is a major win for AI tools that help people focus and be productive.

lines.text: Glimpse, a Y Combinator grad, is building an AI app that blocks distractions during work.

lines.text: Its standout feature is real-time focus tracking using your phone's sensors.
